$comment: Capsule hand in Hand path units (hand.tsx's authoring space, before its 0.48 transform): x right, y down. Blender stores (x, depth, -y); depth is negative toward the camera. At rest the palm faces the camera, fingers up, thumb on the left. Finger radius and spacing are the library's 6.4-wide round-tipped fingers; phalanx lengths are adult averages (mm) scaled so four touching fingers span the palm (0.305 units/mm). Only the middle knuckle height is calibrated (against grip).
